summary: 本轮检索到 2 项 2026-08-25 首次公开且与灵巧手/灵巧操作高度相关的新工作：一项是用于高保真灵巧操作捕捉的光纤传感手套，另一项是面向机器人灵巧操作的耐久型视觉触觉指尖。两者都把手部感知或手部捕捉放在主线位置，因此纳入本次更新。
summary_en: This run found 2 newly public items from 2026-08-25 that are highly relevant to dexterous hands and dexterous manipulation: a fiber-optic sensing glove for high-fidelity manipulation capture and a durable vision-based tactile fingertip for robotic manipulation. Both place hand sensing or hand capture at the center, so they are included in this update.

items.title: Fiber Optic Sensing Glove for High Performance Dexterous Manipulation Capture
items.authors_or_org: J.D. Peiffer, Taylor Niehues, Li Guan, Ziyi Kou, Ergys Ristani
items.relevance: 该工作直接面向灵巧操作中的手部姿态捕捉，解决遮挡、光照变化和传感漂移导致的高质量示教获取问题，与灵巧手数据采集和遥操作高度相关。
items.relevance_en: This work directly targets hand-pose capture for dexterous manipulation and addresses the difficulty of collecting high-quality demonstrations under occlusion, lighting variation, and sensor drift, which is highly relevant to dexterous-hand data collection and teleoperation.
items.novelty_signal: 2026-08-25 新提交的 arXiv 论文，摘要给出了 2 小时灵巧操作数据集、60 Hz 姿态重建和 motion capture 定量对比，属于新增且可验证的公开条目。
items.novelty_signal_en: A newly submitted arXiv paper on 2026-08-25 with an abstract that reports a 2-hour dexterous-manipulation dataset, 60 Hz pose reconstruction, and quantitative comparison against motion capture, making it a fresh and verifiable addition.
items.analysis_zh: 这篇工作主要提出一种基于光纤传感的手套，用于高性能灵巧操作捕捉；它要解决的是灵巧操作中手部位姿难以稳定获取的问题，尤其是视觉方法易受遮挡和光照影响、现有传感手套又容易漂移和受磁干扰。方法上，作者用多芯形状传感光纤重建每根纤维的三维形状，并通过统一参考系配准与新的逆运动学求解器，在 60 Hz 下恢复完整手部姿态。实验包括 5 名受试者的 2 小时灵巧物体操作数据集，并与 motion capture 真实值对比；结果显示平均指尖位置误差为 7.2 mm，经一次工厂标定后可降到 4.9 mm。总体来看，它为高保真示教采集和双手虚拟遥操作提供了实用方案，但公开信息尚不足以判断其在更复杂动作、长期佩戴舒适性和跨手型泛化上的极限。
items.analysis_en: The main contribution is a fiber-optic sensing glove for high-performance capture of dexterous manipulation. It addresses a practical problem in hand-centric robotics: reliable hand-pose tracking during dexterous tasks is difficult because vision suffers from occlusion and lighting changes, while many sensorized gloves drift or are affected by magnetic interference. The method reconstructs each multi-core shape-sensing fiber in 3D, registers the fibers in a shared hand frame, and uses a new inverse-kinematics solver to recover full hand pose at 60 Hz. The experiments use a 2-hour dexterous object-manipulation dataset from 5 subjects and compare against motion-capture ground truth. Results reported in the abstract show 7.2 mm mean fingertip position error, improving to 4.9 mm after a one-time factory calibration that transfers across users and sessions. Overall, the paper offers a credible path toward high-fidelity demonstration capture and bimanual virtual teleoperation, but the public abstract does not provide enough detail to judge performance on more diverse task families, long-term wearability, or broader cross-user generalization.

items.title: A Durable Vision-Based Tactile Fingertip for Robotic Manipulation
items.authors_or_org: F. Richard Cottrell, Megha H. Tippur, Edward H. Adelson
items.relevance: 该工作直接针对机器人灵巧操作中的触觉感知核心部件，重点是提升视觉触觉指尖在高磨损和重复受力场景下的耐久性，属于灵巧手触觉传感的关键支撑技术。
items.relevance_en: This work directly targets a core tactile component for robotic dexterity, focusing on improving the durability of a vision-based tactile fingertip under abrasion and repeated load, which is a key enabling technology for dexterous-hand sensing.
items.novelty_signal: 2026-08-25 新提交的 arXiv 论文，摘要明确给出加速磨损测试和重复加载测试，并与 GelSight Mini 和 DIGIT 做了对比，属于新增且有定量支撑的公开工作。
items.novelty_signal_en: A newly submitted arXiv paper on 2026-08-25 with explicit accelerated wear and repetitive-load tests, plus comparisons against GelSight Mini and DIGIT, making it a fresh and quantitatively grounded addition.
items.analysis_zh: 这篇工作主要提出一种耐久型视觉触觉指尖，用于机器人灵巧操作中的接触感知；它要解决的是现有商用视觉触觉传感器在磨损和集中载荷下容易失效的问题，这会限制其在高强度机器人任务中的实用性。方法上，作者采用软硅胶凝胶、带纹理的薄 TPU 保护膜以及可更换感知模块，形成可维护的传感结构，并通过旋转砂磨和 39.2 N 重复按压两类加速测试评估耐久性。实验结果显示，在定义条件下该传感器可承受约 2 到 3 小时砂磨，重复按压测试中 9 个样品都保持可用，且与 GelSight Mini、DIGIT 相比，耐久性提升超过两个数量级。总体结论是，渐进式损伤与快速更换式结构有助于实现更实用的触觉指尖，但公开摘要未说明其在真实灵巧操作闭环控制中的系统级表现，也未给出更复杂接触任务下的长期验证。
items.analysis_en: The main contribution is a durable vision-based tactile fingertip for robotic manipulation. It tackles a concrete problem in dexterous-hand systems: commercial vision-based tactile sensors often wear out quickly under abrasion and repeated concentrated loads, which limits deployment in demanding manipulation workloads. The proposed method combines a soft silicone gel, a textured thin TPU protective film, and a replaceable sensing cartridge to improve survivability while keeping tactile imaging usable. The experiments use two accelerated durability tests, namely a rotating-drum sanding test and a repetitive probe test at 39.2 N and 45 cycles per minute. According to the abstract, the sensor reached rupture after roughly 2 to 3 hours of sanding, and all nine tested sensors remained functionally usable during repetitive loading, with endpoints at 5, 6, and 8 days. Compared with GelSight Mini and DIGIT specimens, the reported durability improvement is more than two orders of magnitude under the tested conditions. Overall, the paper is a strong hardware contribution for tactile dexterity, but the public information is still insufficient to determine how the design performs in full closed-loop dexterous manipulation tasks, long-horizon field use, or broader system integration.
